promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar
promises.quote: gives us the confidence that whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

promises.label: Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai operational
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
promises.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27, and we will continue to update you transparently on our progress every quarter.

promises.label: Market growth multiplier
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar
promises.quote: Sir, revenue growth, we have committed the 2x of the market growth. The first quarter the market has grown at 17% and we have grown at more than 45% in our -- 48% in our EMS business.

promises.label: OSAT and PCB full year revenue
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar
promises.quote: As far as OSAT and PCB is concerned, we already told from third quarter the revenue starts in both the business, and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.

promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar
promises.quote: Our first 3U satellite is currently in the prototype development phase, and we expect it to be ready to launch in middle of next year, once the required regulatory testing is complete.
